title: Composite VPC deployment health probes with Terraform lifecycle hooks
creator: Asha Raman
description: Deliver a reusable set of composite health probes and SLO probes for Private/VPC deployments that are exposed as configurable Terraform module outputs and include upgrade lifecycle hooks. The goal is to ensure private control planes can reliably detect: tail and p95/p99 latency regressions, API/keyed error-rate spikes, node saturation (CPU/GPU/memory/IO), and token throughput anomalies. Probes must be composable (node-level + service-level), surfaced to Prometheus/Alertmanager, and include upgrade-aware actions (drain, warm-caches, temporary fallback routing) driven from Terraform apply/upgrade steps.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Terraform module exposes probe configurations (latency, error_rate, saturation, token_throughput) as inputs and outputs and can be enabled/disabled per deployment environment.

A2: Composite probe template provided: combines node-level (nvidia_smi, cpu_percent, memory_util) with request-level metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, 5m error_rate, tokens_per_min) into a single health verdict for autoscaler and rollout systems.

A3: Upgrade lifecycle hooks implemented: on terraform replace/update of compute pools the module triggers a controlled drain, KV-cache warmup job, and a temporary routing rule to fallback model variant until post-upgrade probes pass.
A4: Probes export Prometheus metrics and labels consistent with our existing metrics schema; Alertmanager alerts created for SLO breaches with runbook links.
A5: End-to-end tests: synthetic traffic generator CronJob with configurable token distributions validates token throughput probe; test suites pass in pipeline.
A6: Documentation: README + example terraform usage + runbook for incident responders published in Confluence and linked from module outputs.
A7: Security review completed for probe endpoints and credentials; sensitive outputs are marked to use KMS and not printed in logs.
implementation_notes: Create a new Terraform module 'redwood/vpc-health-probes' (v0.1) with inputs: enable, thresholds map, probe_interval, warmup_window, fallback_model_version.
Implement a lightweight composite-checker service (Go) that accepts probe templates and emits a single health verdict; expose it as a sidecar or central metrics exporter depending on deployment size.
Probe types: latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), error_rate (5m sliding window), saturation (GPU_util, CPU_load, io_wait), token_throughput (tokens/min per pod and aggregate), kv_cache_hit_ratio.

Implement Terraform lifecycle hooks using null_resource + local-exec that call the control-plane API to: mark node for drain, create KV-cache warmup job, switch traffic weights (canary -> fallback), and validate post-upgrade probes before un-draining.
Add Grafana dashboard template and Prometheus recording rules (slo.vpc_health) for efficient SLO computation.
Create e2e job 'vpc-probe-e2e' in CI to deploy module to a small test VPC, run synthetic workload, and assert probe verdicts and fallback routing behavior.
Keep the composite service stateless where possible; store transient state about warmup in a Redis lock scoped to deployment to avoid races during parallel upgrades.
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with infra + runtime teams. Agreed scope: terraform module + composite-checker service + CI e2e. Owner: Mateo.

2026-03-05: Prototype of probe schema completed (proto + JSON schema). Added fields for token distribution and kv_cache_hit_ratio. Feedback from runtime: include kernel-compat fingerprint in saturation probe.
2026-03-08: PoC null_resource hooks using local-exec implemented. Hook sequence validated: drain -> warmup -> switch weights -> validate -> undrain. Needs hardened retry/backoff.
2026-03-10: Synthetic traffic generator (k8s CronJob) implemented and tested locally; parameterization for token-length distribution works.
2026-03-12: Initial Prometheus rules drafted. Security requested that probe control endpoints authenticate with mTLS and do not log sensitive outputs. Security review task opened.

Ravi Patel (security): Confirmed mTLS + KMS for any probe-triggered lifecycle actions. Marked module outputs that contain sensitive values as sensitive in Terraform.
Nina (product): Make sure the fallback routing keeps SLA for premium customers; add policy to skip fallback for P0 traffic unless explicit override.
Mateo Liu: Working on integrating the composite checker as optional sidecar; central-checker option will be flagged for large dedicated pools to reduce cardinality.
Asha Raman: Add a record of how runbook steps map to Alertmanager alerts. Also require a post-upgrade smoke test that verifies p50 and tokens/min within expected ranges.
